definitions.explanation: A government official who handles administrative and clerical duties, as opposed to technical or specialized officers. A formal title used in Japan's civil service system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧{事務官|じむかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a court clerk.

examples.japanese: {事務官|じむかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}→採用試験：29861_saiyoushiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the administrative officer recruitment exam.

examples.japanese: {外務省|がいむしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事務官|じむかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わる→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧。
examples.english: Administrative officials at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are also involved in international affairs.

notes: In the Japanese civil service, {事務官|じむかん} is contrasted with {技官|ぎかん} (technical officer). Common compound terms: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧{事務官|じむかん} (court clerk), ⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧{事務官|じむかん} (prosecution clerk), ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧{事務官|じむかん} (foreign affairs administrative officer). The title indicates a general administrative role within a government ministry or agency. Compare with ⟦{事務員|じむいん}→事務員：25266_jimuin⟧ (office worker — used for private sector), ⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧ (bureaucrat — higher-ranking).
